TVS Motor Targets 80,000 Monthly Electric Two-Wheelers by March 2027 Amid Rising Demand

30 Oct 2026, 08:25 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Auto Desk · Source: www.business-standard.com

2 min read

Key takeawaysTVS Motor Company has announced plans to scale up its electric two-wheeler manufacturing capacity to 80,000 units per month by the end of March 2027. According to company Chief Executive Officer KN Radhakrishnan, the firm currently operates at a capacity of approximately 60,000 to 65,000 units monthly.

In this article
  1. Expanding Production to Meet Market Momentum

Expanding Production to Meet Market Momentum

TVS Motor Company has announced plans to scale up its electric two-wheeler manufacturing capacity to 80,000 units per month by the end of March 2027. According to company Chief Executive Officer KN Radhakrishnan, the firm currently operates at a capacity of approximately 60,000 to 65,000 units monthly.

The strategic capacity enhancement comes in response to rising demand for electric scooters across the domestic market. Company disclosures indicate that electric vehicle penetration has reached 11 to 12 percent in the overall two-wheeler market, while surpassing the 20 percent threshold specifically within the scooter segment.

Sales Growth and Industry Standing

TVS Motor reported significant sales gains in the second quarter, with electric two-wheeler sales more than doubling to 1,86,186 units compared to 80,009 units during the same period in the previous year. Domestic electric two-wheeler sales for the company rose by 129 percent during the quarter, outpacing the broader industry volume growth rate of 84 percent.

The executive noted that the wider electric two-wheeler industry expanded by nearly 75 percent during the first half of the financial year. TVS management anticipates that this growth momentum will persist through the second half of the year, driven by sustained consumer demand.

Competitive Landscape and Broader Outlook

Within the market, TVS Motor holds a leading position in the electric two-wheeler segment. However, competition is concurrently scaling operations. Competitor Bajaj Auto is likewise working to enhance its Chetak production capacity to 80,000 units, while Ather Energy is increasing capacity at its existing facility to over 41,000 units ahead of a new facility rollout.

While the electric segment shows strong expansion trajectories, TVS management expects the volume growth rate of internal combustion engine (ICE) two-wheelers to moderate in the second half of the year due to a high base effect from the previous year.

Practical Implications and Verification

Readers tracking automotive sector developments and electric vehicle adoption can evaluate these production milestones against broader market trends.

What is confirmed:

  • TVS Motor plans to reach 80,000 monthly electric two-wheeler units by March 2027.
  • Current operational capacity stands at 60,000 to 65,000 units.
  • Q2 electric two-wheeler sales reached 1,86,186 units, up from 80,009 units year-over-year.
  • EV penetration is noted at 11-12 percent in the total two-wheeler market and over 20 percent in scooters.

What remains unknown:

  • Specific capital expenditure figures or financial allocations for the capacity expansion.
  • Detailed timelines for intermediate production milestones between the current output and March 2027.

Readers can review the original corporate disclosures and official reporting via Business Standard.
